name: passport-photo-specs
description: Official photo and signature upload requirements for common passport, visa and ID applications, each with its official source.

units.kb: 1 KB = 1,000 bytes. Forms differ on whether 1 KB is 1,000 or 1,024 bytes; staying under the 1,000-byte figure passes both.
units.head_ratio: Head height (bottom of chin to top of head) as a fraction of the image height.

documents.name: US passport photo
documents.background: Plain white or off-white, no shadows
documents.glasses: Not allowed, except with a signed medical statement
notes: Neutral expression or natural smile, both eyes open, facing the camera

sources.title: U.S. Department of State: Passport photos

print.note: Only if a printed photo is asked for

sources.title: U.S. Department of State: Visa photo requirements
U.S. Department of State: Digital image requirements

documents.name: Diversity Visa (DV Lottery) entry photo
documents.photo_age: Taken within the last 6 months, showing how you look now
notes: Head covering only if worn daily for religious reasons, with the full face visible
Scanning a print: 2 x 2 in (51 x 51 mm) scanned at 300 pixels per inch
A photo for each person on the entry: entrant, spouse and each unmarried child under 21
Rules are from the DV-2026 instructions, the latest published at the time of checking

sources.title: Federal Register: Diversity Visa Instructions for DV-2026
U.S. Department of State: Digital image requirements
U.S. Department of State: Electronic Diversity Visa Program (official entry site)

documents.name: UK passport photo (online application)

digital.crop: Do not crop to passport size: include head, shoulders and upper body

documents.background: Plain, light-coloured, in clear contrast to you
documents.photo_age: Taken within the last month; a new photo for every new passport
notes: Must be unaltered by computer software

sources.title: GOV.UK: Digital photo rules for passports

documents.name: UK passport photo (paper form)
documents.photo_age: Taken within the last month; a new photo for every new passport
notes: Professional print quality on plain white photo paper, no border
Not cut down from a larger photo
Must be unaltered by computer software

sources.title: GOV.UK: Printed passport photo requirements

documents.name: Schengen visa photo
documents.background: Plain, light-coloured; white is accepted everywhere
notes: Head covering not allowed, except for religious or medical reasons
Usually 1-2 printed photos; check your visa centre's checklist
No official digital file size; each visa centre sets its own upload rules

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic: Schengen visa photo (EU Visa Code)

documents.name: India e-Visa photo
documents.background: Plain white or light-coloured, no shadows, no border
notes: Full face, front view, eyes open, head centred

sources.title: Indian Visa Online: Photo upload guide (PDF)

documents.name: Indian passport photo (Passport Seva upload)
documents.background: Plain, light-coloured (white is safest), no shadows
notes: Face covers about 80% of the photo, head straight and centred
Eyes open, natural expression (no smiling or frowning), forehead and ears visible
Dark clothes; no cap, hair or hijab over the forehead; a turban must be light-coloured
No filters or photo editing
Photo and signature can be uploaded up to 12 times in total, then uploads are blocked

sources.title: Passport Seva photo/signature upload instructions (PDF)
VFS Global (USA): Checklist, adult reissue of passport (PDF)
Government of India: Passport Seva

documents.name: Indian passport signature (Passport Seva upload)
notes: Sign with a bold black or blue pen on plain white paper
Crop a rectangle around the signature; don't upload the entire page
Photo and signature together: up to 12 uploads

sources.title: Passport Seva photo/signature upload instructions (PDF)
Government of India: Passport Seva

documents.name: OCI card photo
documents.background: Plain, light-coloured, no shadows on the face or behind
documents.glasses: Allowed, but no glare, no tinted or dark lenses, and frames must not cover the eyes
notes: Full face, front view, eyes open and level, natural expression, both edges of the face visible
Head covering only for religious reasons, with the face from chin to forehead and both edges visible
Do not retouch, enhance or soften the photo
File-size limits are quoted differently by different sources; staying under 200 KB passes the stricter figure

sources.title: Government of India: Requirement of photograph for OCI Registration (PDF)
VFS Global (USA): OCI services information
Government of India: OCI Services (official portal)

documents.name: OCI card signature
notes: Aspect ratio is written as 1:3 (height : width): three times wider than tall
Children who can't sign give a left-hand thumb impression instead
File-size limits are quoted as 200 KB or 500 KB by different sources; staying under 200 KB passes both

sources.title: Government of India: Requirement of photograph for OCI Registration (PDF)
VFS Global (USA): OCI services information
